assets.description: Plain black wool Tudor flat cap: softly gathered low crown, narrow sewn band and warm upper-left brush highlights; no jewels or ornament. Image-model inpaint on the registered master bust, isolated with soft alpha edges and seated over the crown, clear of banner arms.

Simple cream linen turn-down collar with softly folded points, warm glazed creases and a thin dark umber cord tied at centre front. Image-model inpaint on the master bust, isolated without skin and registered to the neck/garment opening; no chain, gems or embroidery.
